How to flash from Windows (recap, simplified)
1. USB driver (once only)

Install CH340 driver: https://www.wch.cn/downloads/CH341SER_EXE.html
Plug in your board
2. Install PlatformIO (once only)

In VS Code: Extensions icon → search "PlatformIO IDE" → Install → let it reload VS Code
3. Build + flash

Click the alien-head PlatformIO icon on the sidebar
Under "PROJECT TASKS" pick your board:
2.8" → esp32-cyd
3.5" Hosyond → esp32-e32r35t
Expand it, click Upload
4. If it hangs at "Connecting..."

Hold BOOT, tap RESET once, keep holding BOOT a couple seconds after "Connecting..." appears, then release
